proposed_fixes.title: Mouse Without Borders does not reconnect after both PCs resume from sleep
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Peer transport/session state may remain stale when both machines suspend, leaving the connection unable to recover until the MWB process restarts.
plan: Trace peer connection and socket recovery when local and remote suspend/resume events occur in either order.
Reset or renegotiate stale transport/session state on resume without a full process restart.
Add a two-endpoint regression test for simultaneous sleep/resume and delayed network availability.
verification: With both endpoints asleep, wake both and verify MWB reconnects without exiting/restarting PowerToys.

comment.body: Thanks for the repeatable sleep/resume sequence and earlier report. Could you confirm the PowerToys version on both PCs, then reproduce once and comment `/bugreport` from each computer before restarting MWB? If Settings/tray is unavailable, use `BugReportTool.exe` from the PowerToys installation directory. Reports from both endpoints can distinguish stale local state from a peer-side handshake failure.
